headline: The effectiveness of implementing case-based learning in improving clinical skills, critical thinking, problem solving, motivation, and satisfaction of nursing students: Systematic Review
name: The effectiveness of implementing case-based learning in improving clinical skills, critical thinking, problem solving, motivation, and satisfaction of nursing students: Systematic Review
description: Objectives: This study aimed to identify and analyze in improving nursing students’ clinical skills, critical thinking, problem-solving, motivation, and satisfaction. Methods: A systematic review was employed. This article has been compiled in accordance with the PRISMA method. Article searches were conducted using PubMed, EBSCOhost, ProQuest, ScienceDirect, the Cochrane Library, and Scopus. Structured research questions using the PICO method, and search keywords based on Boolean combinations. A total of 590 articles were identified, and 6 were included based on the research question. The included articles were assessed using the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme and the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. To determine the article’ s quality, the Effective Public Health Practice Project was used. Results: There were 6 articles included in this study. Regarding the results of the critical assessment, the implementation of case-based learning can significantly improve nursing students’ clinical skills, critical thinking, problem-solving, motivation, and learning satisfaction. Conclusion: Implementing case-based learning for nursing students can improve clinical skills, critical thinking, problem-solving, motivation, and student satisfaction with learning. Therefore, the CBL method is recommended for nursing education.

hasPart.name: Introduction
hasPart.description: This section introduces the background and rationale for implementing case-based learning in nursing education. It outlines the study's objective to identify and analyze the effectiveness of this educational approach on students' clinical skills and critical thinking.

hasPart.name: Results
hasPart.description: This section details the findings from the selected articles following the systematic review process. It presents the outcomes related to how case-based learning impacts nursing students' problem-solving abilities, motivation, and overall satisfaction.

hasPart.name: Discussion
hasPart.description: This section interprets the findings of the systematic review in the context of existing literature. It explores the implications of case-based learning for nursing curricula and highlights the benefits and challenges observed across the included studies.

hasPart.name: Conclusion
hasPart.description: This section summarizes the primary insights derived from the systematic review regarding case-based learning in nursing education. It emphasizes the positive effects on clinical competence and offers recommendations for future educational practices.
